amplitude_damping.parameter_convention: gamma in [0, 1]: gamma is the |1> -> |0> decay probability.

bit_flip.parameter_convention: p in [0, 1]: E(rho) = (1-p)rho + p X rho X.

depolarizing.parameter_convention: p in [0, 1]: E(rho) = (1-p)rho + p I/2 on the targeted qubit.

metadata.aer_method: AerSimulator(method='density_matrix') with the same Kraus instruction
metadata.basis_convention: Qiskit little-endian: basis index is |q1 q0>; target qubit 0 is the rightmost displayed bit, so X on q0 maps |00> to |01>.
